General introduction
The field of Chemistry has 6 specializations:
Organic chemistry
Inorganic chemistry and its applications
Polymer Chemistry
Physical Chemistry
Analytical chemistry
Pharmaceutical chemistry
natural compounds
Researching methods for extracting organic compounds from natural sources.
Determining the chemical composition and structure of medicinal plants using modern spectroscopic and chemical methods.
Testing for biological activity such as anticancer, antimalarial, antioxidant, hypoglycemic, memory enhancement, etc.
Semi-synthesis of bioactive derivatives and application-oriented studies; essential oils: research on factors affecting quality and content.
Determine physical and chemical properties, and chemical composition.
Bioactivity testing; isolation of single fragrances; semi-synthesis of fragrances.
Organic synthesis
Research and application of synthesis processes for the preparation of: pharmaceuticals, pesticides, insect attractants, plant growth regulators, dyes, organic materials, etc.
Applying green chemistry to organic synthesis and the synthesis of bioactive compounds aims to minimize environmental pollution and promote economic growth.
Green catalysts: enzymes, phase transfer catalysts, metal triflates, homogeneous/heterogeneous catalysts, etc.
Greening agents: dimethyl carbonate, hydroperoxide, etc.
Green environments: ionic liquids, water, solvent-free, etc.
Inorganic materials
Synthesis, morphological structure study, and applications.
Environmental treatment materials
Photocatalytic materials based on modified semiconductor oxides are used in environmental and water treatment and chemical synthesis; redox catalytic materials based on Ni metal, oxides, heterogeneous Fenton catalysts, etc., are used in environmental treatment; and adsorption and ion exchange materials.
Materials used in energy conversion applications
photosensitive cells; solar cells
Industrial materials
Pigments are used in paints, ceramics, glass; adhesives, cement; protective coatings for metals; metals, alloys; magnetic materials; fertilizers, slow-release fertilizers.
Bioinorganic materials
Metal-organic complexes; breaking down waste PET bottle caps to create polymers with biocompatible material value.
Techniques for conducting chemical reactions
Continuous reaction system CSTR, discontinuous reaction system BR
Naturally derived polymers – biodegradable polymers
Natural polymers:
chitin, chitosan-graphene, chitosan-Fe3O4 for biomedical applications, cellulose.
Biodegradable polymers:
polylactic acid (PLA), poly(caprolactone), starch combined with additives.
Polymer composites and nanocomposites
Synthesis and applications of graphene oxide-graphene, polymer reinforcement using graphene/graphene oxide
Composites reinforced with plant fibers, bamboo fibers, nano-clay (clay minerals), nano-silica (from rice husks), etc.
Demonstrates the ability to work independently, think creatively and critically, behave professionally, and adapt to social developments.
Demonstrate effective presentation and technical report writing skills.

Output standard
1. Knowledge
The ability to apply fundamental knowledge of natural and social sciences, basic and specialized chemistry knowledge as a foundation for solving practical problems in the field of Chemistry.
The ability to apply and analyze in-depth scientific knowledge in various fields of Chemistry such as: Organic Chemistry, Inorganic Chemistry, Physical Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Polymer Chemistry, and Pharmaceutical Chemistry (scientific knowledge and reasoning).
2. Skills
The ability to proficiently apply basic computer skills and computer science used in chemistry to social communication and professional activities.
The ability to proficiently use necessary instruments, tools, and laboratory techniques in solving problems related to chemistry.
Khả năng tư duy hiệu quả và nghiên cứu phát triển nhằm định hướng cho nghiên cứu của bản thân và ý thức được việc tự học tập, tự nghiên cứu và học tập suốt đời từ đó có khả năng tiếp cận với những hướng phát triển mới và kết nối giữa nghiên cứu quy mô phòng thí nghiệm với phát triển ứng dụng
Khả năng tổ chức, sắp xếp công việc và làm việc độc lập; giao tiếp hiệu quả, tự tin trong môi trường làm việc nhóm, thích ứng với sự thay đổi khi đổi môi trường làm việc
Khả năng sử dụng thành thạo tiếng Anh tổng quát và tiếng Anh chuyên ngành
3. Thái độ
Kiến thức văn hóa và đạo đức nghề nghiệp, trung thực trong khoa học, trách nhiệm trong công việc và tôn trọng các kết quả nghiên cứu khoa học
Ý thức công dân, hiểu biết và tôn trọng luật pháp, ý thức được cống hiến cho sự nghiệp xây dựng và bảo vệ tổ quốc
4. Trách nhiệm nghề nghiệp
Khả năng phân tích, đánh giá bối cảnh xã hội có liên quan đến ngành nghề, hiểu biết các vấn đề kinh tế – xã hội để định hướng phát triển nghề nghiệp
Khả năng tự học tập, tích lũy kiến thức, kinh nghiệm để nâng cao trình độ
Khả năng thiết kế, tiến hành thực nghiệm, phân tích để cho ra sản phẩm mới và dần hoàn thiện chúng
Cơ hội nghề nghiệp
Cử nhân Hóa học có khả năng tham gia giải quyết tất cả các vấn đề liên quan đến hóa học như hóa chất, thực phẩm, dược phẩm, môi trường, y tế, vật liệu…. tại các viện nghiên cứu, trung tâm kiểm nghiệm, đơn vị sản xuất, công ty kinh doanh khoa học kỹ thuật, các trường đại học, cao đẳng và trung học với vai trò như nhà nghiên cứu và phát triển, kiểm nghiệm, kinh doanh, quản lý, giảng viên.

The field of Chemistry has 6 specializations:

Pharmaceutical chemistry
natural compounds
Researching methods for extracting organic compounds from natural sources.
Determining the chemical composition and structure of medicinal plants using modern spectroscopic and chemical methods.
Testing for biological activity such as anticancer, antimalarial, antioxidant, hypoglycemic, memory enhancement, etc.
Semi-synthesis of bioactive derivatives and application-oriented studies; essential oils: research on factors affecting quality and content.
Determine physical and chemical properties, and chemical composition.
Bioactivity testing; isolation of single fragrances; semi-synthesis of fragrances.
Organic synthesis
Research and application of synthesis processes for the preparation of: pharmaceuticals, pesticides, insect attractants, plant growth regulators, dyes, organic materials, etc.
Applying green chemistry to organic synthesis and the synthesis of bioactive compounds aims to minimize environmental pollution and promote economic growth.
Green catalysts: enzymes, phase transfer catalysts, metal triflates, homogeneous/heterogeneous catalysts, etc.
Greening agents: dimethyl carbonate, hydroperoxide, etc.
Green environments: ionic liquids, water, solvent-free, etc.
Inorganic materials
Synthesis, morphological structure study, and applications.
Environmental treatment materials
Photocatalytic materials based on modified semiconductor oxides are used in environmental and water treatment and chemical synthesis; redox catalytic materials based on Ni metal, oxides, heterogeneous Fenton catalysts, etc., are used in environmental treatment; and adsorption and ion exchange materials.
Materials used in energy conversion applications
photosensitive cells; solar cells
Industrial materials
Pigments are used in paints, ceramics, glass; adhesives, cement; protective coatings for metals; metals, alloys; magnetic materials; fertilizers, slow-release fertilizers.
Bioinorganic materials
Metal-organic complexes; breaking down waste PET bottle caps to create polymers with biocompatible material value.
Techniques for conducting chemical reactions
Continuous reaction system CSTR, discontinuous reaction system BR
Naturally derived polymers – biodegradable polymers
Natural polymers:
chitin, chitosan-graphene, chitosan-Fe3O4 for biomedical applications, cellulose.
Biodegradable polymers:
polylactic acid (PLA), poly(caprolactone), starch combined with additives.
Polymer composites and nanocomposites
Synthesis and applications of graphene oxide-graphene, polymer reinforcement using graphene/graphene oxide
Composites reinforced with plant fibers, bamboo fibers, nano-clay (clay minerals), nano-silica (from rice husks), etc.

Output standard
1. Knowledge
The ability to apply fundamental knowledge of natural and social sciences, basic and specialized chemistry knowledge as a foundation for solving practical problems in the field of Chemistry.
The ability to apply and analyze in-depth scientific knowledge in various fields of Chemistry such as: Organic Chemistry, Inorganic Chemistry, Physical Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Polymer Chemistry, and Pharmaceutical Chemistry (scientific knowledge and reasoning).
2. Skills
The ability to proficiently apply basic computer skills and computer science used in chemistry to social communication and professional activities.
The ability to proficiently use necessary instruments, tools, and laboratory techniques in solving problems related to chemistry.

Khả năng phân tích, đánh giá bối cảnh xã hội có liên quan đến ngành nghề, hiểu biết các vấn đề kinh tế – xã hội để định hướng phát triển nghề nghiệp

Khả năng thiết kế, tiến hành thực nghiệm, phân tích để cho ra sản phẩm mới và dần hoàn thiện chúng
